messages:
maggie.marketing: Quick heads-up
Draft v1.3 of the launch post is live: https://docs.google.com/example/launch-v1.3. Need copy + legal + final CTA/UTM values today so we can queue publish and webinar invites.

sam.copy: on it. Top edits: tighten hero to one line, move customer quote earlier, and remove marketing superlatives.

maggie.marketing: yep one-line hero + 2-line kicker. Sam, aim to push changes in the next 90 mins.

devon.growth: CTA buckets we want: hosted trial, dedicated trial, enterprise pilot. Proposed utm_content values: hosted_trial, dedicated_trial, enterprise_pilot.

nate.ops: UTMs look good. CRM mapping I'll create: blog_launch_mql and blog_launch_enterprise. Quick snippet I'll use:
```
utm_campaign=redwood_launch_may2026
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=cta
utm_content=hosted_trial|dedicated_trial|enterprise_pilot
```
Will wire routing after final UTMs confirmed.

elaine.legal: Reviewed. Two asks: delete the phrase "best in class" and add a sentence under Security: "Supports SOC2 + optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and configurable retention." After that I can approve.

sam.copy: removing "best in class" and adding the KMS line now. Also swapping order to put the customer quote above the technical paragraph.

devon.growth: benchmarking note: link to appendix PDF for full data, include a one-line takeaway in body. Keeps page load light.

maggie.marketing: agreed. Add: "See benchmark appendix for methodology and full results." Sam, add a one-line takeaway with placeholder percent we will finalize after QA.

alex.events: Webinar: Tue May 12, 2026 at 16:00 UTC. Recommend reserving 12 demo slots post-webinar + waitlist. Draft calendar blurb: "Launch + live demo: 30-min walkthrough + 15-min Q&A."

devon.growth: Sales ask: anyone who selects enterprise_pilot and visits /pricing should be flagged as PQL. Nate can you add that rule?

nate.ops: will add pixel and workflow: visit_pricing && utm_content=enterprise_pilot => tag: blog_launch_enterprise + assign to AE queue.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo set for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: when final copy is approved.

maggie.marketing: timeline recap: Sam finalizes copy by 14:30 UTC, Elaine legal signoff by 15:00, Devon confirms UTMs/tracking by 15:15, Alex finalizes invites. If all green we lift embargo tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone.
